poses.caption: Lie on the side with knees bent and hands lightly behind the head.
Lift the upper body and stacked bent legs toward each other, squeeze the side, then lower slowly; finish repetitions and switch sides.

jobs.detail: SIDE-LYING CRUNCH WITH BOTH BENT LEGS LIFTED, TWO equal SQUARE panels side by side, SAME FRONT-side three-quarter camera/model/scale. Lie on LEFT side on thin gray mat, HEAD IMAGE LEFT FEET RIGHT. BOTH knees bent together about90degrees, legs STACKED in same plane, chest faces camera, pelvis rests side on mat. BOTH hands LIGHTLY behind head/ears elbows open, no hand pulling neck. LEFT lower/start: side torso lengthened close to mat, bent stacked legs rest mat, same side-lying orientation. RIGHT crunch: side-flex trunk to lift shoulders/head UP toward ceiling and right hip while BOTH stacked bent knees/feet lift together from mat toward ribs, shorten upper-side waist; BALANCE on LEFT lateral pelvis, hips stay mat, not a forearm side plank, not bicycle twist, do not extend legs. Keep both bent legs together, both feet clearly off mat in right phase. Neck neutral with torso, head not pulled forward, both hands stay lightly behind head. Primary abdominal red only ONE smooth diffuse BLURRED tint on intact side abdominal black shirt, no anatomical divisions on fabric. Fine exposed grayscale arms/calves, full opaque front sides back seat crotch.
jobs.prompt: Correct original project TWO-panel side-lying bent-knee crunch. Keep same adult, fine detailed EXPOSED grayscale muscles, opaque black clothes front sides back seat crotch. LEFT lower/start stays lying on LEFT SIDE with bent STACKED knees/feet resting mat, hands lightly behind head. RIGHT contraction must remain on LEFT LATERAL PELVIS, with pelvis/hips still facing camera as first, NOT roll onto buttocks/back or become seated V-up. Lift shoulders moderately toward top hip and BOTH stacked bent knees/feet together off mat, shorten upper-side waist. Preserve same bent-leg orientation, no rotation/twist. Both hands light behind ears, neck aligned no tug. ONE smooth diffuse BLURRED red teaching tint on side abdominal shirt, erase streaks/rays/anatomical divisions in cloth; broad natural folds only. Recompose WIDE LANDSCAPE TWO equal SQUARE cells side by side with full head/elbows/shoes and margins, minimal unused top/bottom white space. No text.
jobs.inspectionNote: Shirt tint softened with broad folds; bent stacked legs lift with upper trunk. Correction did not clearly keep lateral pelvic contact: contraction still reads seated/supine rolled balance. Full opaque clothes and fine exposed grayscale anatomy retained. Blocked for qualified side-lying pelvic support and crunch mechanics review.
